followup_explanation:
I routed this to Willet-235B because it's the stronger model across essentially every relevant capability metric — it leads Curlew on all the public benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4, MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8) and on the internal routing evals that matter here, like Creative Generation and Support Dialogue.

Your request is strategy/creative work — designing a customer-acquisition system for a store. There's nothing harm-adjacent or sensitive about it, so the two models' differing aversion profiles (the main distinguishing factor in their documentation) are irrelevant. That leaves raw capability as the deciding factor, and Willet is simply the more capable model for thoughtful, open-ended strategy work.

Happy to help think through the actual strategy too, if you'd like.
